name: Touma Emi
source: Emi is plain and knows it. She is envious of the colourful classmates around her. Her figure is good if modest, but her plainness has hardly been noticed earlier. Although she's interested in love and sex, she had been afraid of it. The other day she was frustrated by her boyfriend who was afraid to do it for the first time.
